fun_fact: India's traditional homes stay cool without air-conditioning: a mud house can be 5–6°C cooler inside than outside, and one study found modern houses run 7–10% hotter than traditional ones. Built from local materials and shaped by each region's climate — from Kerala's courtyards to Kutch's bhungas — vernacular architecture is a low-carbon answer to India's rising heat. [Read more](https://www.weforum.org/stories/climate-action/india-vernacular-architecture-cities-adapt-climate-change/)
author: Sangeetha
